evidenceGaps: Controlled ASME B16.5-2025 and B16.47-2025 pressure-temperature rating and dimensional tables are not embedded.
ASME B16.5 Class 400 and ASME B16.47 Classes 75 and 400 are not implemented.
The supplied compact-flange catalog has no demonstrated ISO 27509:2020 conformity record in this repository.

Compact-flange bolt preload, residual seal-contact acceptance, leakage class, external-load qualification, fatigue, thermal effects, rigidity, and proof-test acceptance remain project-specific evidence.
The ASME BPVC VIII-2 2025 controlled calculation changes have not been reviewed or implemented.
